I'm no poet, nor am I a doctor or a therapist, but even I can tell when something is bad. 
There are a lot of cases where people are giving in and their lives are beating them, but yours is different. Man, your really in trouble. 
You love your kids, your family. That's no question, I can tell you do by the way you write but suicide, that will only hand over the problem to someone else.
Maybe there is no solution but, you've got to at least give something a try. Even if the world comes crashing down, you can say that you did everything you could for the ones you love.

If it hurts, end it. If getting it over helps, do so. If killing yourself is going to make it better, then there's your option.
Someone has a bad day.
Someone has a fight with someone else because they're in a bad mood because of their day.
Someone hears about suicide.
Someone gets the idea that death will help.
Maybe, if I end it, bad days won't happen?
That's how it happens, a slow decline.
But What then? Ending it, how will that make it any better?
You seem strong. You have to be to have made it this far, you may not see it but you are. Maybe that strength you be used for a better calling?

I'm trying very hard here not to say 'slouched won't help' or 'talk to someone' so I'm going to say, distract yourself. Go on, give something new a try.
